hero.body: Handmade clothing inspired by diverse cultures and crafted with love. Celebrating individuality and sustainability, one unique piece at a time.

story.body: What started as home-cooked meals shared between neighbors has grown into a full celebration of Habesha food, beauty, and lifestyle. Every dish, garment, and gift we offer carries the same care we'd bring to our own family table.
story.amharic: Every dish tells a story of home.

kitchen.body: Every dish is simmered, spiced, and plated the way it's always been done, slow-cooked stews, fresh injera, and recipes passed down rather than shortcuts taken.

catering.body: From intimate family gatherings to full wedding receptions, our catering team brings the same authentic flavor and warm hospitality to every table we serve.
